verdicts.reason: A keeps one clean left edge for the whole text stack, but the headline breaks badly and leaves 'back' alone on its own line. The GROVE wordmark has been made much bigger and bolder, losing the original's small tracked style. The FREE DELIVERY tag is stuck below the CTA near the bottom edge, and the pills sit too close to the CTA. B wraps the headline well and keeps the tag top-right, but mixes three alignments with no logic: GROVE is centred, the headline and body copy are left-aligned, and the pills and CTA are pushed right. The CTA floats off the text column and the layout looks unplanned.
